title: New website update!
content:
I had a vision early last summer

of a place away from Instagram, but then Bluesky got kinda annoying too and... Well I realized I should probably start preparing for the eventual great shittening of the internet and all its popular platforms. To start my own little Noah's ark. Also, having a website is kinda cool. Kid me thought owning a domain was the coolest thing you could do. So I did it. 

My dream

is this becomes part of a web of comic creators slowly becoming independent from these shitty platforms currently ruling over our daily lives. I want to create a space for people to explore and feel chill vibes. Maybe a connection. OH ALSO make a comic that enriches people lives. makes them laugh, lets the escape. That might be the main thing actually.
Anyway that's all for now... ALSO ISSUE 7 IS OUT, HERE! YIPPEEEE, go look at it. Smell it.

Okay bye, I wanna go play some Halo.
boywonder/doylemelville II/DJ
